cases.rationale: Unknown worktrees are diagnosed without mutation, while only exact persisted create or finish intents are recoverable.

cases.title: A2: --reuse-worktree → 成功复用
cases.rationale: Path-only adoption is retired; a worktree is resumed only when its repository, path, branch and HEAD match a persisted create intent.

cases.title: A3: --ignore-orphans → 新建 worktree
cases.rationale: Unrelated unknown worktrees remain visible but no longer require a global ignore flag before a collision-free managed create.

cases.title: A4: --reuse-worktree 路径无效 → exit 2
cases.replacement: absolute managed-root and state identity validation
cases.rationale: Invalid, repository-internal or symlinked roots are rejected before any worktree intent is written.

cases.title: A5: 复用后 worktree 内旧改动仍在
cases.rationale: Unknown worktree changes are reported with residue facts but never imported into a new delivery branch.

cases.title: A6: 多个孤儿 → 全部报出
cases.rationale: All managed-root, registered, unregistered and branch-only findings are returned in one read-only report.
